name: publish
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      packages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: oras-project/setup-oras@005458ad77f1c8facd38a094e4af2e69e5607ff4 # v2.0.2
      - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@6f9f17788090df1f26f669e9d70d6ae9567deba6 # v4.1.2
      - id: push
        run: |
          digest=$(oras push "ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" --format go-template='{{.digest}}' policy.yaml)
          echo "digest=${digest}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: cosign sign --yes "ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}"
